method: offline Unicorn run of the original entry wrappers over the memory image; nothing hooked out; 0x18f0a70 runs natively and its result is captured at 0x19d5930 and supplied to the model as the point_query service; a code hook asserts execution stays in the allowed ranges
fixtures: XYZ mask {-1,-1,-1,0} (initializer 0x400c7e60); 1 case in 16 of the forward runs uses a random mask
TEB+0x10 StackLimit for __chkstk 0x1c45120; TEB+0x58 TLS array, epoch 1 at block+0x4eec
function-local static 0x3336a30 pre-set to its initializer value (RVA 0x29ca870, 1e-7 x4), guard 0x3336a40 = 1
convex shapes: support lookup pointer +0xc0 = 0 (brute-force vertex scan path only)
comparisons: all 0x270 bytes of the out area (13 records, only record 0 may change)
geom, both shapes, vertex, plane block and plane bytes unchanged
model inputs to the point-query service equal the native call arguments (frame rows, shape, point, 16)
bit-exact float32 lanes under the emulator two-NaN rule
limits: 0x18f0a70 is not restated: the model consumes its native result. Its own correctness (GJK convergence, the count-1 vertex scan in 0x1949480) is outside this receipt.
The +0xc0 support-lookup path of 0x1949480 is not exercised.
Two-NaN lanes compared under nan_rule x87 (QEMU softfloat); the manual rule differs in the counted cases.
MXCSR is the Unicorn default 0x1f80; the live MXCSR is not established.
Swap wrappers are run with the standard mask only; their frame lane 3 is uninitialised stack.
Synthetic fixtures; no live shapes. Kinds 4/5 identification is from field use, not from a live shape.
